deathBeat: d18: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Jorge Bautista is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d18: 🕯️ Jorge Bautista is dead — the wild. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d18: The village's quarrel was with Jorge — and Jorge is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d18: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Big Big is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
recoverHome: d19: That night, they bring Jorge home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
systemVoice: d18: SYSTEM: "Perimeter violated! This is unprecedented! ...Is this unprecedented? Checking. Yes. Unprecedented."
d18: 📺 SYSTEM: "We have already cleared your morning. You are welcome. We require 300 kcal of tubers and your full attention. The fans love a cooking segment."
d19: SYSTEM: "INTRUDER REPELLED. The pantry’s aroma is now classified as a defensive liability. The audience is chanting the defenders’ names. Fan clubs are forming. This is how it starts."

d19: ◈ ARC III — ENGINES. SYSTEM: "VIEWERSHIP MILESTONE. Organic unit demonstrates compounding capability. Resonance protocols unlocked." — Your gifts deepen. Used in sequence, they resonate. The village is no longer just surviving. It is becoming something.
burialWindowSay: d18: The village's quarrel was with Jorge — and Jorge is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d19: That night, they bring Jorge home. Nobody asks you to help carry; nobody has to. By morning the grave is dug by the fire, and the body is laid out beside it. The filling of it is yours.
d20: Not guilty. The count falls short — you breathe. But an accusation leaves a mark no verdict washes off. Some faces at the fire say they'll remember anyway.
d21: You say a few words for Jorge. Not a ceremony — just: you were here, and someone noticed you leaving. (-3 trauma)
d21: You bury Jorge. A marker, of sorts. The village will know where. (+4 trauma)
d21: ◈ The System files the name away with visible satisfaction. It has so few words for things that bleed. (+2 integration)
echoSample: d25: "You want to know about that? Okay." "I dreamed Jorge was still here. Woke up angry at the dream. Stupid."
echoV2Sample: d21: The village raises a marker by the fire — Jorge, day 21. the wild. A place to stand.
